item.title: Wisconsin judge convicted of obstructing arrest of immigrant resigns as GOP threatens impeachment
item.description: Courtesy: AP Embattled Wisconsin Judge Hannah Dugan, who was convicted of obstruction last month for helping an immigrant evade federal officers, has sent her resignation letter to the governor. item.description: DULUTH, Minn. — People gathered at the Duluth Folk School to learn and sing sea shanties.
